'''HHG-RX''' was an [[RX-series pilot droid/Legends|RX-series pilot droid]] that existed during the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It could frequently be found hitch-hiking at [[Spaceport THX1138]]. It was identifiable with it giving the thumb gesture for hitchhiking and holding a pendant resembling the [[Marksman-H combat remote]].

==Behind the scenes==
HHG-RX was a droid that was seen among the "Grim Grinning Droids" section of the Queue for the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of the ride ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'', where a trio of droids mimic the poses of [[W:c:Disney:Hitchhiking Ghosts|three ghosts]] seen in [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney's]] [[Wikipedia:Haunted Mansion|Haunted Mansion]] attraction. Its name can be identified on a container near it, and was a slight pun on its activities ("HHG" stands for "'''H'''itch-'''H'''iking '''G'''host").
